I've never had a game give me laugh out loud moments like this game has.  It is very reminiscent and a marked improvement over Deep Rock Galactic.  Activating Strategems will have you feeling like a one-handed ninja out of Naruto.

-however-

Let's skip right on past the nProtect thing because that's been thoroughly discussed:

The one cool thing (Strategem activation) shows up everywhere.  Every console, every computer, every objective will have you entering in a left-handed Konami-code to progress the story.  Kiss your left hand goodbye.

The game is intentionally slow.  You can't skip past the summary screens, the character drives like it came out of trucking simulator, the "sprinting" is walking just slightly faster.  It's supposed to be a fast-action combat game but the aiming is slow, the movement is slow, your character moves like a stoned Robo-cop (if you rapidly shift from left to right he walks in a stupid little semi-circle), the cutscenes are slow, the loading screens are slow...but the bugs are FAST AS ♥♥♥♥!!!

They use that annoying "pop-in out of your field of view" mechanic for spawning, I've literally had bugs pop-in directly under my feet because my slow-ass helldiver moves faster than their servers.

There are pathing issues galore.  Your character gets stuck on nothing and has to "dive" out to move again.  I get stuck in the extraction plane all the time.  I constantly find dropped supplies inside of mountains and hills where they are inaccessible.  I'm constantly getting stuck in the terrain.  Once the game dropped me on a mountain then killed me for being on the mountain.  If you stand near a bile-titan it will launch you into space and kill you.

Diving fixes everything.  Literally everything.

Often times during combat your gun "jams up" I guess.  You go to reload it, it takes a magazine but doesn't refill your ammo, and it won't shoot, but reloading it again doesn't take a new magazine but DOES fill up your ammo, so I'm not sure if that's an intentional feature meant to ♥♥♥♥ with you during combat or if me running/sprinting/diving is interrupting my reload and it's a bug.

The game is sinfully unresponsive.  Perhaps related to the "reload bug", more often than not, your reloads, heals, stratagems, shots will do absolutely nothing and you will have to repeat/redo actions to get them to take effect.  For a game centered around fast-paced action, the amount of lag and failed actions that are allowed in this game is a crime against humanity.  I can't tell you the number of times I've heard the "stim" sound and not gotten any healing.  Likewise, I can't tell you the number of times I've gotten 5-6 health-bars worth of health out of 1 stim while I get slapped around the battlefield like the new guy in the jail cell with free candy bars falling out of my ass.

This game is an A+ GOTY recommend if you like exploding at random for no perceivable reason whatsoever.  It's probably due to lag/invisible mines.

Why is there a 3s call in time for orbital drops?  I mean, I GET IT, it's coming from space, but nothing sits still for 3s.  They're bugs, they're unintelligent, but for some reason if they hear a noise that's an objective they all swarm to that spot and kill everything that moves, but if they hear a noise that's an orbital drop they scatter away from that point.

It is a micro-transaction hell.  There are credits, super credits, war bonds, PREMIUM war bonds, common materials, uncommon materials, rare materials...  Neverwinter nights has premium transactions and it's free.  Gotta pay for that "live service" I guess.

The interface is bad.  There is no "M" for map, there is "tab" for minimap and to ping the map you have to HOLD the right click button, DRAG the map until the crosshairs is on it then "right" click.  Why can't I just unlock my mouse and click on it?

It's buggy as hell, probably mostly due to lag.  While it is hilarious when the citizens burst into flames right in front of you for no perceptible reason, when it says "shuttle launch in 20 seconds" AS the shuttle launches and leaves your ass there, ... well, no, that's still ♥♥♥♥♥♥' hilarious.

The guns are underwhelming.  All of them.  Like, just straight up disappointing.  I finally upgrade from a light penetration gun to a medium penetration gun and it's the same 2.5 inches I've been getting all along.  It still takes 3 full mags to kill anything.  I'm not sure what vehicle the "anti-material sniper weapon" is supposed to be against, but it's sure as ♥♥♥♥ not any vehicle in THIS game.  It'll knock the ♥♥♥♥ out of an infantry though, and that's hilarious.

Even the railgun, whose entire focus is "armor penetration" happily bounces bullets off of a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ cockroach.  I mean, I get it, the chitin is tough as iron, but it's stronger than A RAILGUN!?!   Get over yourself.  Centipedes are pretty tough too and they die to a slippah.

Can't report players for slurs in voice chat or team killing, so the player base is toxic as ♥♥♥♥ and acts with impunity.  It is funny when they throw your spawn beacon out of bounds so you get nuked and labeled as a traitor as soon as you spawn in.

I've died so many times to trolls, friendly fire, and griefing that I've given up being sweaty about it.  The whole game is artificially sustaining itself on FOMO and extrinsic value.  It won't be long before the life-support goes out and frankly, no one will notice.

Even if you get past all of that, crashing to desktop during extraction and loosing an hours worth of rewards is kinda funny I guess.  Then they pop up a screen asking what I was doing when it crashed like they don't have a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ rootkit installed on my machine to monitor exactly that.
